svg.text: TwoSkulls — v3: centered flush USB-C, flat underside components
Review draft • cutout dimensions, cable interference and riser height require a physical fit check
Coordinates stay component-side; shaded parts are UNDERNEATH.
Arches = insulated crossings, not solder joints.
*Slot / antenna offsets are illustrative; measure first.
Side view: flush socket and possible cable interference
Slot lets connector PCB hang underneath; retain the flange.
Dashed plug bodies show the intended interference only.
Test actual cables in both insertion orders before relying on it.
Underside: capacitor lies flat, protected by risers
Clearance = capacitor diameter + support/wiring + shell-flex gap.
Provisional C1 diameter 10 mm; C3 diameter 6.3 mm.
Actual connector tail depth may require taller risers.
Side views are conceptual, not dimensioned fabrication drawings.
26 × 32 holes · 2.54 mm pitch · assumed 25.4 mm socket-row spacing · no verified cutout template or cable interlock
